A '''[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] lineage''' was active within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]], where it was considered to be a great [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] bloodline. During their time as an [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolyte]] at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the [[Sith Warrior]] who would later become the [[Empire's Wrath]] claimed to be the heir to the bloodline.<ref name="Allegiance" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I am heir to a great Sith bloodline. How dare you even ask such a question of me?|The [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]] to [[Sith Inquisitor|Inquisitor]] [[Arzanon]]|<ref name="Allegiance" />}}
The Empire's Wrath's Sith bloodline was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the mission, "Allegiance", on Korriban. When [[Sith Inquisitor|Inquisitor]] [[Arzanon]] questions if the player character is truly loyal to the Sith, a Sith Warrior has the option to claim to be the heir to their bloodline, regardless of the player's chosen gender or species.<ref name="Allegiance" />
